title: Velvet curtain
logline: A real 3D stage: velvet curtains part, the mark is flown in from the flies and lands in the spotlight pool.
hook: Frame 0: a slit of gold light between closed velvet curtains.
risk: Heaviest to render (WebGL); the mark moves in 3D, so it must come to rest square to camera (brand: no rotated mark).
why: The only direction that is true 3D, and it acts out the brand idea itself: the curtain opens, the show starts.

title: Marquee
logline: A lit theatre marquee: bulbs chase around an empty board, then the mark and wordmark light up inside it.
hook: Chasing bulbs on a dark board, one word: tonight.
risk: Flat 2D; close to a generic 'coming soon' sign

title: Spotlight
logline: No curtain: one follow-spot searches a dark stage and finds the mark.
hook: A cone of light rakes across empty boards.
risk: Mostly dark frames: weakest thumbnail in a feed

title: Arcade marquee
logline: An 8-bit marquee says now showing; the board pixel-dissolves into the mark.
hook: A pixel marquee chasing: NOW SHOWING, PRESS START.
risk: Pixelating the mark is an effect on the artwork (BRAND.md don'ts): only the transition may touch it, never the resting mark
